name: SCREEN_MAX_X
evidence: 0x27F=639=SCREEN_WIDTH-1, the inclusive right edge. All 22 occurrences are Render_FillRect/blit/surface x1 coordinate args (e.g. 040_world_map.inc.c:1949 Render_FillRect(0,surf,0,0,0x27Fu,0x1DFu,0,0)); none are masks/comparisons.

name: SCREEN_MAX_Y
evidence: 0x1DF=479=SCREEN_HEIGHT-1, the inclusive bottom edge. Scoped to the y1 slot immediately following the x1 max (0x27F/SCREEN_MAX_X) in a full-screen Render_FillRect/blit - the proven full-screen pattern. NOTE: 0x1DF=479 also occurs as a battlefield X extent (070_battle.inc.c Render_FillRect x1 slot paired with 0x1CF=463 bottom); those are NOT screen-max-Y and are excluded by this pairing constraint (initial bare-value rule wrongly caught 4 such sites; corrected).

name: SCREEN_WIDTH
evidence: Render_CreateSurface(surf, 640, height) first dimension arg is the full display width; 640 also confirmed by CreateWindowExA(...,640,480,...) (110_platform_input.inc.c:286) and g_Device_DefaultWindowRect{0,0,640,480}.

name: SCREEN_HEIGHT
evidence: The 480 immediately following a 640 (full 640x480 surface/window/rect): Render_CreateSurface(surf,640,480), CreateWindowExA(...,640,480,...), g_Device_DefaultWindowRect{0,0,640,480}. Scoped to the 640,480 adjacency so partial-height 480 coordinates elsewhere are untouched.
